mentions.name: SaaSufy
mentions.description: A backend platform (SaaSufy) aimed at vibe coders, providing ready-made backend infrastructure with built-in security, analytics, advanced data sharing scenarios, and realtime updates. Claude can be given full access to the control panel and impersonate any role to exhaustively test all data models and views, allowing exhaustive security verification of all data in the system.
mentions.problem: App builders using AI ('vibe coders') need a secure backend without having to build it themselves; the platform supplies a backend their AI doesn't have to build.
mentions.audience: Vibe coders — developers building applications with AI assistance.
